title: He built drug-delivery technology now in clinical trials. In 2026, America's medical academy took notice.

sources.text: ASCO Post - National Academy of Medicine Elects 100 New Members for 2026
American Bazaar - 2026 NAM class includes five Indian Americans

caption:
He built drug-delivery technology now in clinical trials. In 2026, America's medical academy took notice.

The Duke University biomedical engineering professor was recognized for developing the first artificial polypeptides to enter clinical trials for sustained protein-drug delivery, announced October 19, 2026.

Now the Alan L. Kaganov Distinguished Professor of Biomedical Engineering, his work spans protein purification and PEGylation technology used in treatments worldwide.

Chilkoti's election is a reminder that India's engineering pipeline feeds directly into the institutions that set the terms of global medicine.
